author: Hexbit Studios
title: Hiring pixel art animator for Dungeography game
content:
Hiring: a part-time pixel art animator for Dungeography, an HD-2D dungeon crawler where a Triple Triad style card duel builds the dungeon you fight through.

Paid and remote. Hero, enemies and bosses on a 32 px grid. $25 to $40/hr. Hand-made art only.
